label: early steps / <DEL> after a prefix rich in u,j,v,1,3,2,p,h
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at t=2..6 and on the <DEL> step (about 98% of mass; copy phase about 1.6%). Never fires at t=0 or 1. It depends on the prefix: it is strongest when the tokens before it include several of u,j,v,1,3,2,p,h (prev2_tok=u has 6.6x lift, first_tok=1 has 4.4x). The current input matters too: <DEL> or a first occurrence of w,e,r,d,t,x,s. Top activations are <DEL> in short sequences (L=3-5) whose prefix is mostly from this set. Precision is poor: many steps that match the prefix pattern stay silent, so this looks like a distributed readout of hidden state rather than one crisp feature. It does not fire on repeated tokens (in_first=0 is 0.1x) or in the copy phase. Magnitude rises with how many prefix tokens come from the set (n_seen>=3 is more concentrated in the top quartile); that was checked only roughly.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & out_tok=1 (+4.59), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+3.54), orig0=1 (+3.04), orig0=3 (+2.70), phase=2 & in_tok=a (+2.58), phase=2 & out_tok=j (+2.49). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-6.06), phase=2 (-5.59), in_tok=j (-3.91), in_tok=3 (-3.83).
